label: An archive worth sharing
summary: Make a start on a book or learning material from work you have collected.
imageAlt: Directly overhead view of an older man in a rust cardigan sorting archive photographs and working papers in a home office.
acxHeading: What ACX looks like when you shape an archive.
acxIntro: From finding a theme to working with an editor:

acx.name: Chat
acx.action: Find the story in a small collection.
acx.detail: Share a few notes or photo captions you can use. Ask AI for possible themes, then discuss which fits your experience.
acx.control: You check names, dates and meaning against the originals.

acx.name: Workflow
acx.action: Turn each batch into an outline.
acx.detail: Build a routine: label the material, summarise it, check the summary, then add it to a chapter outline with source references.
acx.control: You keep only the themes and passages that fit your purpose.

acx.name: Agent
acx.action: Have an agent prepare a chapter draft.
acx.detail: Give it an approved outline and selected sources. Ask it to draft one section, flag gaps and pause for your review.
acx.control: You check the sources and voice before it drafts more.

acx.name: Teamwork
acx.action: Bring an editor into the project.
acx.detail: Agree how you and an editor use AI to organise sources and suggest edits while you shape the book or learning material together.
acx.control: People check permissions, preserve your voice and decide what to publish.

title: AI Coaching for Archives and Personal Projects | GreenElephant
description: Learn to use AI with your notes, interviews or research. Explore an outline and a small sample for a book or learning project, with human coaching.
headline: Turn a lifetime of work into something others can learn from.
intro: Give your notes, interviews, films or research a new purpose. Explore a book or learning project without losing your voice.
audience: Researchers, educators, filmmakers and anyone ready to pass on a collection of work or experience.
example: A few notes, photographs or interview extracts you own or have permission to use, with their source labels.
practice: Keeping source references attached to your material.
Choosing themes that reflect your intention.
Editing an AI draft in your own voice.
takeaway: Work towards an outline and a tested sample within an agreed scope. A finished book is a larger project.

faq.question: Do I need to digitise everything first?
faq.answer: Start by discussing the material and its format. We can agree which small, usable sample to bring and what preparation it needs.

faq.question: What happens to private material?
faq.answer: You decide what can be used. We discuss permissions and tool settings before uploading anything; confidential items can stay out of the exercise.

invitation: Tell us about the material—and who you hope it will help.

label: A new business idea
summary: Explore an idea and choose a practical next test.
imageAlt: Directly overhead view of a woman in a mustard jumper reviewing a rough prototype and sketchbook at home.
acxHeading: What ACX looks like when you test a venture.
acxIntro: From customer questions to a small real-world trial:

acx.name: Chat
acx.action: Write questions for potential customers.
acx.detail: Describe your idea to AI. Work together on five questions that help you learn what people need before you build anything.
acx.control: You listen to real people; AI's guesses are not evidence of demand.

acx.name: Workflow
acx.action: Turn feedback into a one-page offer.
acx.detail: Use the same steps each time: summarise anonymised feedback, check the themes, draft an offer and choose one small test.
acx.control: You check that the offer reflects what people actually said.

acx.name: Agent
acx.action: Ask an agent to prepare your trial.
acx.detail: Give it your offer, budget and limits. Have it draft a trial plan and feedback questions, then stop for your review.
acx.control: You approve the plan before anything is sent or money is spent.

acx.name: Teamwork
acx.action: Run a small test with a partner.
acx.detail: Agree who talks to customers, who delivers the trial and how AI helps organise feedback for your next discussion.
acx.control: You and your partner decide whether to continue, change or stop.

title: AI Coaching for Your Next Business Idea | GreenElephant
description: Explore a new business idea through personal AI coaching. Clarify a customer problem, draft an offer and plan a small test using your experience.
headline: Explore your next business idea with AI—on your terms.
intro: Turn your experience into an idea you can test. Use AI to prepare; learn what works from real people.
audience: People exploring a venture after a career change or alongside their work. No finished business plan needed.
example: A rough idea for a service, who you think it could help, and any anonymised feedback you already have.
practice: Explaining an offer in your own words.
Choosing what a small test should teach you.
takeaway: Work towards an offer draft, a list of assumptions and one manageable experiment—not a prediction of business success.

faq.question: Will AI tell me whether the idea will work?
faq.answer: AI can suggest possibilities, but real people provide the evidence. We help you distinguish a promising suggestion from an assumption that still needs testing.

faq.question: Can I bring an idea that is still rough?
faq.answer: Yes. A question such as “Could my experience help someone with this problem?” is enough for a discovery conversation.

invitation: Bring the idea you keep coming back to.

label: Everyday AI confidence
summary: Learn through useful tasks from your own life.
imageAlt: Directly overhead view of a young man in a blue shirt checking a letter and handwritten list at a kitchen-table workspace.
acxHeading: What ACX looks like in everyday life.
acxIntro: Choose the level that helps your task. You do not need all four.

acx.name: Chat
acx.action: Make sense of a confusing letter.
acx.detail: Remove private details, then ask AI to explain the letter in plain language. Ask follow-up questions about anything unclear.
acx.control: You compare the explanation with the letter and check with its sender if needed.

acx.name: Workflow
acx.action: Make a routine for writing replies.
acx.detail: Save a simple sequence: explain the message, list what you want to say, draft a reply and check it before sending.
acx.control: You check the details and make the reply sound like you.

acx.name: Agent
acx.action: Have an agent research a day out.
acx.detail: Set your budget, travel range and interests. Ask it to find three options with sources and return a shortlist for you to check.
acx.control: You confirm prices and opening times. Nothing gets booked without you.

acx.name: Teamwork
acx.action: Plan the outing with other people.
acx.detail: Agree who checks transport and who asks about access needs. Use AI to bring the agreed details into one shared plan.
acx.control: Everyone chooses what to share and agrees the final plan.

title: Personal AI Coaching for Everyday Life | GreenElephant
description: Learn to use AI through everyday tasks you choose. Practise asking clear questions, checking answers and keeping control, with patient personal coaching.
headline: Feel more confident using AI in everyday life.
intro: Learn at your pace with a human coach, using a message, a personal plan or information you want to understand.
audience: Adults starting with AI, with any level of technical experience.
example: A letter with private details removed, a message to draft or an outing you would like to plan.
practice: Giving context without unnecessary private details.
Asking follow-up questions when something is unclear.
Checking sources and making a draft your own.
takeaway: A few practised tasks and simple notes to help you try them again.

faq.question: What if I find AI overwhelming?
faq.answer: We start with one task and explain each step. There is room to ask questions and repeat what needs more practice.

faq.question: Can someone else arrange the journey for me?
faq.answer: Talk with us about who will attend and who will pay. The learner helps choose the goal and what they want to share.

invitation: What is one everyday task you would like help with?

label: Facilitation and coaching
summary: Prepare and follow through while keeping your attention on people.
imageAlt: Directly overhead view of a facilitator in a plum overshirt arranging yellow notes and workshop materials at home.
acxHeading: What ACX looks like in facilitation and coaching.
acxIntro: From an opening question to a shared session pack:

acx.name: Chat
acx.action: Find an opening question that fits.
acx.detail: Give AI a fictional or approved session brief. Ask for three opening questions and refine one for your group or coaching conversation.
acx.control: You judge whether the wording feels useful, inclusive and appropriate.

acx.name: Workflow
acx.action: Build a repeatable session routine.
acx.detail: Connect an approved brief to an agenda and activity sheets. After the session, use agreed notes to draft a follow-up message.
acx.control: You review each document and keep confidential details out of AI tools.

acx.name: Agent
acx.action: Have an agent draft the session pack.
acx.detail: Give it the goal, timing and approved materials. Ask for an agenda first; after your review, let it draft the activity sheets.
acx.control: You check timing, accessibility and fit before using the pack.

acx.name: Teamwork
acx.action: Prepare together with a co-facilitator.
acx.detail: Agree who leads each activity and reviews the materials. Use AI to combine approved edits into a shared agenda and follow-up draft.
acx.control: Facilitators read the room, adapt the session and approve what is shared.

title: AI Training for Facilitators and Coaches | GreenElephant
description: Build a practical AI workflow for preparation and follow-through. Personal coaching for facilitators and coaches who want to keep their attention on people.
headline: Use AI around your work. Keep your attention on people.
intro: Use AI for preparation and follow-up, with your professional judgement guiding what reaches the people you work with.
audience: Facilitators, business coaches and learning designers ready to turn AI experiments into a working routine.
example: A fictional or approved session brief, its goal and timing. No client recordings needed.
practice: Turning a brief into useful preparation questions.
Adapting activities to a particular group.
Checking a summary against the session notes.
takeaway: A preparation-to-follow-up routine you have tested, with clear review points.

faq.question: Is this coaching from an AI chatbot?
faq.answer: Your learning is guided by a human coach. You practise with AI tools as part of your own professional work.

faq.question: Do I need to bring client recordings?
faq.answer: No. Use a fictional, anonymised or explicitly approved example. Client recordings are not needed to learn the steps.

invitation: Which repeatable part of your work would you like to improve?

label: AI in your professional work
summary: Practise with tasks you understand and tools your workplace allows.
imageAlt: Directly overhead view of an older woman in a green blouse checking reports and source notes in a home office.
acxHeading: What ACX looks like in specialist work.
acxIntro: From checking one summary to reviewing a report with colleagues:

acx.name: Chat
acx.action: Get a summary you can check.
acx.detail: Give AI a report your workplace allows you to use. Ask for its key findings, open questions and the source passage behind each claim.
acx.control: You compare every important claim with the original report.

acx.name: Workflow
acx.action: Create a routine for recurring reports.
acx.detail: Connect approved notes to a report template, then check the facts and revise the draft. Reuse those steps for the next report.
acx.control: You check figures, missing context and conclusions before sharing.

acx.name: Agent
acx.action: Ask an agent to compare sources.
acx.detail: Set one question and the sources it may use. Ask it to compare findings, flag disagreements and return a referenced brief for review.
acx.control: You verify the references and investigate gaps before relying on the brief.

acx.name: Teamwork
acx.action: Review a report with your colleagues.
acx.detail: Agree who researches, who checks and who approves. Use AI for assigned drafting and comparison tasks within your team's permitted tools.
acx.control: Named people resolve disagreements and sign off the final report.

title: AI Coaching for Experienced Professionals | GreenElephant
description: Use your expertise as the starting point for learning AI. Practise reports, research or recurring work with personal coaching; discuss employer sponsorship.
headline: Keep your expertise. Build new ways of working with AI.
intro: Learn AI through work you know how to judge. Your expertise is the starting point, not something to replace.
audience: Experienced specialists learning independently or through their employer, with no prior AI skills required.
example: A public or workplace-approved report, its sources and one question you would like it to answer.
practice: Turning your expertise into clear instructions.
Comparing AI claims with reliable sources.
Making a reusable template and review checklist.
takeaway: A practised task, a reusable guide and a checklist for reviewing future outputs.

faq.question: Can my employer arrange this?
faq.answer: Start with a discovery conversation. We discuss the learning goal, participant needs, scope and fee before a booking is confirmed. Employer payment or reimbursement is not automatic.

faq.question: Can I use workplace material?
faq.answer: Only material and tools your organisation allows. A public, fictional or appropriately approved example can be used for practice instead.

invitation: Bring one professional task you know well and would like to approach differently.
